entities.title: Invoker logic against a mock syscall layer
entities.summary: test/unit.c compiles zazzle_core.h against test/sys_mock.h and drives every path: request layout, the name it runs under, socket path, autostart, waiting, the spin, sending, the execs and every failure with its exit code.
criteria: The request carries an empty cwd field, the session and the arguments, and the four descriptors.

Run as zazz the arguments follow a `zazz` field, under any other name `zazz exec-name NAME`; as zazzle (or with no argv[0]) they go as they are, and only zazzle execs the standalone tools, `zazzled wrap` and `zazzled proxy` (`zazz run NAME` and a script given `proxy` are zazz requests).
ZAZZLE_SOCK overrides HOME, and lookalike variables are ignored.
Autostart picks ZAZZLE_DAEMON or zazzled beside the executable, for both not-running errors, and gives up after the wait.
A fast reply is read during the spin; a slow one falls back to the blocking read; an error ends the spin.
free-disk-space and fix-network exec the tool beside the invoker, and run and proxy exec `zazzled wrap` and `zazzled proxy`, without contacting a daemon; failures exit 69.
A partial send is completed; every failure exits with its code and one line on standard error that starts with the whole `zazzle: ` prefix.

entities.title: Branch coverage of the invoker logic
entities.summary: `make coverage` builds the unit tests with gcov and fails unless the branches of zazzle_core.h taken at least once reach 95%.
criteria: At least 95% of zazzle_core.h's branches are taken by the unit tests.

checks.description: Reads gcov's "Taken at least once" for zazzle_core.h; CI runs it in the coverage job.

entities.title: The real invoker against the real daemon
entities.summary: test/smoke.sh runs build/zazzle against a freshly built zazzled: output, exit status, errors, session dedupe and read-again, standard input, the sha requirement, write confinement, autostart, the execs of the standalone tools, run and proxy, and the invoker run as zazz and as a script's shim.
criteria: Without a daemon that ever listens, zazzle gives up with exactly `zazzle: daemon did not start`, and a missing tool with `zazzle: cannot run the tool (error N)`.
`zazzle version` prints `zazzle` and the version `zazzled version` reports (the release tag's, `0.0.0-dev` in the repository), not a fixed number.
find and read print the expected text; an unknown command exits 2 with its error on standard error.
A daemon zazzle autostarts does not keep zazzle's standard output open.
Linked as `zazz` the invoker reaches the zazz command (`zazz help`); linked under an unknown script's name it fails with `NAME: not_found` on standard error.
A stand-in tool beside the invoker, and a stand-in zazzled named by ZAZZLE_DAEMON, get the arguments and pass their exit status back; a missing tool fails.
The platform backends work on the machine running the test (the unit tests replace them with the mock).

checks.command: make && sh test/smoke.sh (in macos/c/zazzle, after `cargo build --release -p zazzled` in macos/rust; ZAZZLED names another zazzled)
checks.description: CI's zazzle-c job runs it on macos-latest and ubuntu-24.04; the release workflow runs it again on macOS and on Linux x86_64 and aarch64.
